verdict: Client could not locate a distribution point that hosts the requested content. Either no DP in the client's boundary group has the content, or all candidate DPs are offline.
fix: Confirm the client's boundary via `Get-CCMBoundary` (or look at the value of `SMSCFG.INI` / the `ClientLocation.log`). In the console, verify the client's boundary group is linked to at least one DP that holds the content. If boundaries are correct but no DP was returned, restart `CCMExec` on the client to force a location lookup refresh.
